results.title: Barangay Love Stories: Paradise
results.overview: This showcases hope and love amid the challenges that Ling-Ling (Kira Balinger) faces after she gets hit by a vehicle and loses her ability to walk. Amid the loss of hope, she meets Lui (Josh Ford), a physical therapist who helps her learn to walk again and believe in herself. As Lui helps Ling-Ling with her recovery, they gradually fall for each other. Will they face their feelings for one another?

results.title: Doctor Doomscroll
results.overview: An isolated young woman fights to survive a demonic entity that preys on people who are stuck in a social media doomscroll. To make it out alive, she must confront the purposeless person she’s become—and the loved ones she’s pushed away.

results.title: Blow the Horn
results.overview: Three couples arrive at a Brooklyn artist’s studio expecting individual sessions with their psychologist. Instead, they discover their therapist left behind a letter and a series of sealed envelopes instructing them to conduct their own unconventional group therapy session, which quickly spirals into an increasingly volatile confrontation as long-buried secrets, betrayals and uncomfortable truths come to light. As the partners turn on one another and their relationships begin to unravel, the session builds toward a series of revelations that challenge everything they thought they knew about each other.

results.title: Nowruz - New day
results.overview: In Turin, a group of young Iranian women finds community and freedom through Homa, a women’s football team. As they train and compete in Balon Mundial 2025, they build new lives far from home. When war breaks out in Iran, their joy and sense of belonging are challenged by fear for their families and the pain of a wounded homeland.

results.title: The Last Fellini
results.overview: Much has been told about Federico Fellini, but one chapter remains largely unexplored. It is the final decade of his life and artistic career. During the 1980s and 1990s, the film industry celebrated him while struggling to support his visions. The Maestro never stopped creating and fought to continue expressing himself. Sharing his dreams and extraordinary energy were exceptional companions: Roberto Benigni, Martin Scorsese, Nicola Piovani, Vincenzo Mollica, Milo Manara, and his inseparable secretary, Fiammetta Profili. Ultimo Fellini reveals the man behind the icon through three years of research, private archives, and previously unseen footage, beginning with the precious materials of Vincenzo Mollica.

results.title: Secret [Mis]communication System
results.overview: The film is based on the drawings and graphic illustrations taken from the patent “Secret Communication System”, registered as US2292387. When work on radio-controlled torpedoes began in the early 1940s, it became clear that an enemy would have little trouble intercepting the frequency of a control signal. In 1942, to fix that problem, the film actress Hedy Lamarr and the composer George Antheil proposed changing the carrier frequency of transmitter and receiver by means of a perforated paper tape, of the kind used in a player piano. Lamarr and Antheil’s invention folded musical logic into the mechanics of war, fulfilling the modernist utopia’s hope that art and technological progress might pass into one another.
